purpose: Scientifically observed non-event and near-miss evidence kept separately from Jubilee event labels and from fully matched validation controls.

controls.source: Edwin B. May, Extensive Oxygen Depletion in Mobile Bay, Alabama, Limnology and Oceanography 18(3), 1973
controls.mechanistic_interpretation: Hypoxic bottom water was present close offshore but did not complete the final nearshore-contact transition needed to produce a Jubilee at the sampled shoreline.
why_not_fully_matched_yet: Exact predawn observation window has not been recovered.
Tide/current phase has not yet been reconstructed for the sampled interval.
It has not yet been matched to a positive by identical observation availability.
controls.research_use: High-value mechanistic near miss; may test the three-state architecture but must not be counted as a fully matched clean negative until missing matching dimensions are reconstructed.

guardrails: Keep scientifically observed near misses separate from generic no-report days.
Do not inflate matched-control counts with this row until all matching requirements are satisfied.
Do not use later knowledge unavailable at forecast issuance as a predictor.
